page.content:
Sister of Isis who mourns Osiris and guards the dead.

How Nephthys connects

  • Faction: Ennead — Nephthys is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Character: Osiris — Nephthys mourns Osiris and helps Isis restore him.

What is Nephthys?

Nephthys, paired with Set yet allied to Isis in the mourning, stands at the head or foot of coffins and helps reassemble Osiris.

Key threads lead to Ennead and Osiris.
